response.overview: A man somehow falls for both a mother and her daughter. The film shows how a married woman is forced to go beyond the established norms of marriage and how her desire to quench her physical needs makes her fall for a much-younger guy--the very same guy with whom her own daughter is in love. A mix of passion, emotion, and the conventional spicing-up with hot and steamy scenes, make for a decent watch for anyone who enjoys typical masala potboilers.
response.title: Premer Katha Koli
